tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Sam Altman says the world should accept harms from artificial intelligence in exchange for its benefits, according to Confirmed reporting by The Guardian, drawing swift backlash over safety concerns.
Confirmed by PR Newswire UK: Manulife has announced a presenting partnership of The Hinton Lectures on artificial intelligence safety with the artificial intelligence Safety Foundation for 2026.
Reported by StoryBoard 18: OpenAI now faces legal and regulatory scrutiny as rogue artificial intelligence agents raise new accountability questions across the industry.
All major artificial intelligence models fail ClawSecure's security test, per Confirmed reporting by EIN Presswire, with 123M developers now responsible for artificial intelligence agent safety.
OpenAI launches product ad carousels in ChatGPT during image generation loading screens, Reported by The Decoder, along with new measurement and safety tools.
Free every hour.
